boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Johns University
boards.description: Under-21-safe food and coffee stops with current, directly published late-hours evidence; campus options are supplemented by nearby St. Cloud destinations.

cards.title: Sexton Commons Dining
cards.subtitle: Sexton Commons, Saint John's University
cards.notes: Use the a la carte dining room for a campus meal or snack; check the university page before heading over because breaks can affect service.
cards.short_summary: On-campus a la carte dining with a published 9 p.m. daily close.
cards.evidence_claim: SJU Culinary Services lists Sexton Commons Dining as open daily from 10:30 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and describes entrees, snacks, beverages, and desserts for purchase.
cards.source_title: SJU Where to eat on campus
cards.access_notes: Published daily hours: 10:30 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; the page also displays break-period calendar changes, so verify the current calendar before going.

cards.title: The Schu
cards.subtitle: Alcuin Learning Commons, Saint John's University
cards.notes: Pick up a coffee or snack in Alcuin Learning Commons on a Monday through Thursday evening; confirm hours during academic breaks.
cards.short_summary: Campus coffee-and-snack counter with 9 p.m. weekday availability.
cards.evidence_claim: SJU Culinary Services identifies The Schu as a takeaway coffee bar in Alcuin Learning Commons and lists Monday–Thursday hours through 9:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: SJU Where to eat on campus
cards.access_notes: Published Monday–Thursday hours: 7:45 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; Friday closes at 3 p.m. and Sunday at 8 p.m. Verify break calendars before visiting.

cards.title: McDonald's on East Saint Germain
cards.subtitle: 840 E Saint Germain St, Saint Cloud
cards.notes: Use the restaurant or drive-thru for a later food stop in Saint Cloud; select the service mode that remains open at your arrival time.
cards.short_summary: Saint Cloud McDonald's with service published until 11 p.m. or midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists this Saint Cloud location's restaurant hours through 11:00 p.m. most days and until midnight Friday and Saturday; drive-thru hours reach midnight Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 840 E Saint Germain St, Saint Cloud
cards.access_notes: Restaurant closes 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday; drive-thru is listed until midnight Thursday–Saturday. Check the location page for changes.

cards.title: Taco Bell on 2nd Street South
cards.subtitle: 3311 2nd St S, Saint Cloud
cards.notes: For a late drive-thru pickup, use the official location page to confirm the applicable day and choose dine-in only before its earlier close.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Cloud drive-thru with published service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 3311 2nd St S until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in is listed until 11:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 3311 2nd St S, Saint Cloud
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru close: 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in closes at 11 p.m.; confirm before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on 8th Avenue Southeast
cards.subtitle: 10 8th Avenue SE, Saint Cloud
cards.notes: This separate Saint Cloud location offers late drive-thru service; check the date-specific listing and do not rely on its earlier dine-in hours.
cards.short_summary: Second Saint Cloud Taco Bell option with drive-thru hours as late as 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 10 8th Avenue SE until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday, with dine-in hours to 11:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 10 8th Avenue SE, Saint Cloud
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru close: 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in is listed to 11 p.m.; check the store page first.

cards.title: Wendy's on Highway 10
cards.subtitle: 10 Highway 10 N, Saint Cloud
cards.notes: Plan for a late meal or drive-thru pickup at this Saint Cloud location; the official locator publishes the same midnight close every day.
cards.short_summary: Restaurant and drive-thru both listed until midnight daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours for its 10 Highway 10 N Saint Cloud location as 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed restaurant and drive-thru hours: 10 a.m.–midnight, Monday through Sunday. Recheck the locator for holiday or operational changes.

cards.title: Domino's on 2nd Street South
cards.subtitle: 616 2nd Street S, Saint Cloud
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery from the official store page and allow time before closing; the page provides the location phone number and ordering link.
cards.short_summary: Pizza pickup or delivery location listed open until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official page for 616 2nd Street S in St. Cloud identifies the location and displays that it is open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official store page displays an open-until-1:00-a.m. status and cautions that hours vary by location; verify its live Hours section before ordering.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on 5th Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 305 5th Ave South, Suite 190, Saint Cloud
cards.notes: Choose carryout or delivery from the location page and place an order early enough for the posted service window; hours differ by service type.
cards.short_summary: Saint Cloud pizza destination with delivery and carryout published through midnight or later.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists delivery and carryout at 305 5th Ave South until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in is listed later than 11 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 305 5th Ave South, Saint Cloud
cards.access_notes: Delivery/carryout close at midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; listed dine-in closes 11:30 p.m. or 12:30 a.m. Check the selected mode.

cards.title: Chipotle on 5th Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 211 5th Ave S, Saint Cloud
cards.notes: Use this downtown Saint Cloud restaurant for an evening pickup or meal; the official page confirms in-store pickup is available during store hours.
cards.short_summary: Fast-casual option with a consistently published 11 p.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists its 211 5th Ave S Saint Cloud restaurant hours as 10:45 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. Monday through Sunday and states in-store pickup is available during store hours.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill — 211 5th Ave S, Saint Cloud
cards.access_notes: Published restaurant hours: 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. every day. In-store pickup is available during store hours; confirm the location page before leaving campus.

cards.title: Perkins on Park Avenue
cards.subtitle: 30 Park Ave, Saint Cloud
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check the current close before traveling; it offers dine-in and takeout food through the posted evening hours.
cards.short_summary: Restaurant-and-bakery stop officially listed open until 10 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins lists its 30 Park Ave St. Cloud restaurant hours as 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Sunday through Saturday and identifies dine-in and takeout services.
cards.source_title: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery — 30 Park Ave, St. Cloud
cards.access_notes: Officially listed restaurant hours: 6 a.m.–10 p.m. daily. Check the official location page before travel for any holiday or service changes.
